item.title: Apple Q4 2026 Earnings: Stock Slip, Services Record
item.description: Apple’s Q4 2026 results show 12% revenue growth, record services, but an 8% wearables dip and a 10% iPad slump trigger a 3% after‑hours stock fall.

item.title: Apple’s Record iPhone Revenue Signals New Growth Model
item.description: Apple posted an iPhone revenue peak in Q3, driven by just two new models, reshaping expectations for future product cadence and market dynamics.

item.title: Apple’s Record Earnings Spark Investor Skepticism
item.description: Apple posted record revenue, yet analysts balk at cautious margin guidance and a scripted earnings call by new CEO John Ternus, raising concerns.
